title: Raise or Check? Predicting the Necessity of Additional Fuzzing for Continuous Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2610.27828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous fuzzing is used for vulnerability detection in Open Source Software (OSS). Large-scale services such as Google's OSS-Fuzz fuzz over 1,300 projects and have revealed more than 10,000 vulnerabilities. Despite this, a considerable time lag often exists between when a vulnerability is introduced and when it is detected (i.e., the window of exposure). Given the computational cost of additional fuzzing, we aim to allocate fuzzing resources efficiently using vulnerability-risk estimates. We propose RAISE (Risk-Aware Intensive Supplemental Execution Framework), a Just-In-Time (JIT) framework that prioritizes additional fuzzing for high-risk project-days. RAISE performs binary classification at the project-day granularity to estimate whether a vulnerability is introduced on a given day. translated_title: 增投还是检查？预测持续模糊测试中额外模糊测试的必要性
translated_abstract: 持续模糊测试被用于开源软件（OSS）中的漏洞检测。像Google的OSS-Fuzz这样的大规模服务对超过1,300个项目进行模糊测试，并已发现超过10,000个漏洞。尽管如此，从漏洞被引入到被检测出来之间往往存在相当大的时间滞后（即暴露窗口期）。考虑到额外模糊测试的计算成本，我们旨在利用漏洞风险评估来高效分配模糊测试资源。我们提出了RAISE（风险感知的密集补充执行框架），这是一个即时框架，可优先对高风险的项目-日进行额外模糊测试。RAISE在项目-日粒度上执行二元分类，以估计某一天是否引入了漏洞。我们构建了一个数据集，将OSV数据库中引入漏洞的提交与OSS-Fuzz的每日覆盖率和变更指标相结合，覆盖了……
tldr: 提出RAISE即时框架，通过在项目-日粒度上预测漏洞引入风险，优先为高风险项目分配额外模糊测试资源，从而高效利用计算资源并缩小持续模糊测试中的漏洞暴露窗口期。
en_tdlr: RAISE is a Just-In-Time framework that predicts vulnerability introduction risk at the project-day granularity, prioritizing additional fuzzing for high-risk project-days to efficiently allocate fuzzing resources and reduce the window of exposure in continuous fuzzing.
